Name: Multiplayer Exp Sharing
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]

[size=2]Ever played a multiplayer game where you'd have to fight over who gets to harvest the crops, chop the trees and mine the diamond node for exp? With this mod, that is no more! Every exp point you gain i can be configured to be redistributed with nearby, or all players in your game.[/size]

With default settings, the person doing the action gaining exp still gets the majority, however this can be configured to share exp equally. Every skill can also be toggled on and off to work with exp share.

Supports vanilla and Spacecore based skills (Cooking, Travelling etc.)


[size=5][b]How does it work?
[/b][/size]
If you are in range (press 'K' to see overlay with range) of another farmer, then you will share exp you gain with them. By default, you keep 75% of all exp yourself, and the other 25% is shared between all players in your range. It also rounds in favour of the player getting the exp. For example, if you cut a tree (gives 12 exp in total) with 2 nearby players, you will get 12 * 75% = 8 exp. The other players will both get half of 12 * 25% = 3 / 2  = 1 exp. The 2 exp lost due to rounding is given to the person cutting the tree. So in the end, You get 10 exp, and the others get 1 exp each.

[b][size=5]How do I know it's working?[/size]

[/b]If the mod is functioning correctly, pressing 'K' should show you an overlay of the range in which you can share exp. Additionally, there should be particle effects between players that share exp. An example of what the particles look like is in the Media page.
